option.label: Hook profiler (needs restart)
option.desc: Times every plugin's share of the map update, one row per plugin and hook, and appends a report to perf-log.txt in the game folder every 30 seconds or when you press Ctrl+F8. Off, it costs nothing.
option.restart: Takes effect after you restart the game.

enabled: Hook profiler turned on. Restart the game to start profiling.
disabled: Hook profiler turned off. Restart the game to stop profiling.
alreadyOn: The hook profiler is already running.
alreadyOff: The hook profiler is already off.
notActive: The hook profiler is not running. Turn it on and restart the game.
dumped: Hook profile of {frames} frames written to {file}.
dumpedConsole: Hook profile of {frames} frames printed to the console.
